keep_playing_why: A gave me a repeatable duel where position on the gauge, couching late, sailing under a storm with the lance up, and dodging out of reach when only the rival is charged all change the result, and every rival adds a rule plus a Dock loadout layer, so I was playing differently by minute eight. B was a pleasant authored puzzle chain with one correct order. I wanted another round of A and a rematch against Marrow; I only wanted to see B's next area.
better_made_why: B has the more cohesive world, cutaways, and authored puzzle beats, but its camera clipped into walls and pipes, invisible current barriers and the objective marker misled me, and the assist stalled several times. A is highly polished in sound, juice and looks, but the two-thumb timing and the fast gauge are hard to read, and a few early losses felt like unread rules (couching under a storm). Close call; B edges it on art direction and world, A on feedback and audio.
furthest_A: Beat 6 rivals in the ladder (Pip, Barnacle, Doc Volta, Contessa Brisa, Kite Kowalski, The Gilly Twins); reached rival 7 Lady Marrow (Rogue Deep) and lost to her twice (best hits 2-2 trades). Best score 2,500. Unlocked yachts and lances equipped at The Dock; did not try Endless Squall or 2 Players.
furthest_B: Woke all three windmills (Sails, Pipes, Ladders; sky bridge complete), crossed to the Hollow, fed two carvings, descended to the well floor and fought the Guardian: 2 of 3 vanes fed (rose rejected, gold done), teal vane pending with the breath held and 1 of 3 pips left.
